human_review: Contracts and funding starter
A person calls the lender about each old contract, decides what to post, and sends any follow-up or dispute after reading the draft.
F&I office pack
A person decides whether a jacket is complete, runs and judges every OFAC and identity check, and approves any refund, remittance or lender letter.
Floorplan and inventory pack
A person confirms payoff amounts with the lender and pays them, and decides prices, wholesale and recon spending.
Accounting office pack
The controller decides every journal entry, tax figure, title action, payoff and commission paid; the agents only list what to look at.
Fixed operations pack
The service and parts managers decide on warranty resubmissions, adjustments, pay for technicians and returns to vendors.
Independent repair shop
The owner decides what to bill, pay or redo; the agents only list repair orders, hours and invoices that need a look.
Collision pack
A person decides what to ask an insurer for and sends it; supplements and invoices are never filed by the agents.
Whole store
Each department head reviews their own lists; every payment, letter and filing is made by a named person after reading the draft.
Dealer group
Each rooftop's office reviews its own lists and settings; nothing is posted, paid or sent for a store by the agents.
Partner rollout
The firm or consultant reviews each store's lists and settings with that store; every action stays with a named person at the store.
common_problems: Contracts in transit past the store's alert days, contracts the lender returned, and funding the lender sent that was never posted.
Units sold but still on the floorplan past the payoff days, and lender balances that differ from the DMS.
F&I product chargebacks higher than the pro-rata figure, and customer refunds not sent.
Deal jackets missing signed forms (odometer, privacy notice, credit documents) and deals with no OFAC or Red Flags record on file.
Manufacturer incentive and warranty claims not submitted, paid short, rejected or charged back.
Trade-in payoffs not sent, sent after the quote expired, or with no lien release.
Sales tax and DMV fees collected that differ from the county rate or the state charge.
Repair orders sold below the margin floors, comebacks within 30 days, and parts billed but never received.
reaches_the_model: When an AI assistant calls a Fairdrive tool, the agent reads the files on the user's computer and returns a result. Before it leaves the agent, customer names, co-buyers, phones, e-mails, addresses, licence and account numbers, and staff names (salespeople, technicians, advisors, F&I managers) are replaced with stable pseudonyms or placeholders. Deal, stock, RO and claim numbers, VINs, dates, amounts and business names such as lenders and insurers are sent as they are; free-text notes are sent with known names and phone, e-mail and SSN patterns replaced. Results go to whatever model the user's assistant uses; for data that may not be shared with that provider, use a local model or one covered by the user's agreements. The reports written on the user's computer keep the real values.
rules_maintained: Every day count, rate and limit (67 settings, such as the 10-day contracts-in-transit alert, the 90-day full chargeback window, the 75% reserve share and the curtailment schedules) is a working example written for version 0.1.0 on 18 Nov 2026, not a law or any lender's, manufacturer's or state's terms. Each default is in the agent's source and each is a named setting the store passes when the tool runs; tax rates, pay plans and extra deal-jacket documents come from the store's own files. Mythos Machines updates defaults in a new release with a changelog line, and settings updates are part of the support plan.
